name: Adjoint Backpropagation to Tree Nodes
definition: An adjoint query that backpropagates a derivative $db_\varepsilon(x)$ provided by differentiable rendering to all tree nodes that contributed to the dipole sum during the primal query.
summary: Adjoint Backpropagation to Tree Nodes computes gradients for spatial tree attributes by backpropagating derivatives only to contributing nodes, avoiding the linear complexity of visiting all leaves.
